title: Slovakian Pork Roast
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring a slow-cooked roast pork with a zesty twist.
instructions: Season the pork roast with salt, black pepper, and caraway seeds.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the pork roast until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork roast to a large baking dish and roast in the preheated oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
While the pork roast is cooking, sauté the onion and garlic in a pan until softened.
Add the zesty mustard and sour cream to the pan, stirring to combine.
Remove the pork roast from the oven and brush the zesty mustard-sour cream mixture over the top.
Return the pork roast to the oven and continue cooking for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Let the pork roast rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with potatoes and garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
